@graph.name: Sauna & Cold Plunge Warranty | The Toronto Sauna Co.
@graph.description: Warranty coverage for saunas, cold plunges and heaters from The Toronto Sauna Co.: 5 years on all our cedar saunas (red or white cedar) and cold plunge tubs, and how to make a claim.

blocks.html: Every sauna, cold plunge and heater we sell comes with a manufacturer’s warranty. Warranty coverage is provided by the manufacturer, not by The Toronto Sauna Co. as the retailer, and your sales representative will connect you with the right people to start a claim.
blocks.text: Every sauna, cold plunge and heater we sell comes with a manufacturer’s warranty. Warranty coverage is provided by the manufacturer, not by The Toronto Sauna Co. as the retailer, and your sales representative will connect you with the right people to start a claim.

blocks.html: Defects in materials and workmanship under normal residential use: 5 years on red cedar saunas (clear or knotty), 5 years on white cedar saunas, and 5 years on cold plunge tubs. Heater and chiller coverage varies by brand and is listed on each product page and in the documents that come with your order.
blocks.text: Defects in materials and workmanship under normal residential use: 5 years on red cedar saunas (clear or knotty), 5 years on white cedar saunas, and 5 years on cold plunge tubs. blocks.html: Coverage starts on the date your order is delivered or picked up. Repairs or replacements are made with new or refurbished parts, at the manufacturer’s discretion.

items.html: Normal wear and tear, and natural weathering of exterior wood, such as greying, checking and minor cracks.

items.html: Damage from misuse, neglect, accidents, improper installation by others, or alterations.

items.html: Commercial use, unless the product is rated for it.

items.html: Labour charged by third parties, such as electricians or plumbers.

items.html: Products that were not maintained as described in the owner’s manual.
items.text: Products that were not maintained as described in the owner’s manual.

blocks.html: Outdoor saunas need regular care to stay covered. Tighten barrel bands as the wood settles, clean and re-seal exterior wood as recommended, and follow the assembly and maintenance manual. Skipping the required maintenance can void the warranty.

items.html: Contact your sales representative at (437) 429-6623 or sales@thetorontosaunaco.com, with your order number and photos or a short video of the issue.

items.html: You start the claim directly with the manufacturer, who reviews it and arranges the repair or replacement.

blocks.html: Warranty applies to the original purchaser at the original installation address and is not transferable. Nothing in this warranty limits your rights under Ontario consumer protection law.
